messages:
ritesh: Quick check — proposing a gated swap of quant-kernel v3.1 into release-qa tonight during the 01:30-03:30 UTC quiet window. Primary goal: evaluate long-sequence memory behavior and p99 tail.
emily: 👍 need to confirm staging smoke and a bundle pin before we flip anything. also please add a diff job for our top prompt corpus.
ritesh: agreed. plan: staged rollout 10% -> 60% -> 100% with 8m observation at each step. failure criteria: p99 > 2.5s for >5m, token_error_rate > 0.5%, or any OOM on GPU.
deploy-bot: Deploy request queued by ritesh: env=release-qa kernel=quant-v3.1 strategy=staged(10,60,100) window=01:30-03:30. Preflight running.
emily: heads-up: v3.1 changes the GEMM packing path — we saw a small drift in outputs at long seqs in perf lab. should be fine for QA but flagging for model owners.
tariq: I'll monitor KV-cache integrity; if we see cache misses spike, we roll back immediately.
ops-oncall: pinned alert thresholds. adding an incident channel in case we need fast escalation. also ops will have rollback CLI ready.
sam: please pin the bundle hash in the deploy config to prevent accidental auto-updates. I'll push the hash once the build finishes.
deploy-bot: Preflight passed. staging smoke: p50 +0.01s, p99 +0.09s, no OOMs. bundle_hash=sha256:ff12c9...
emily: rollback snippet for quick ops use:
```
deploy-bot rollback --env=release-qa --kernel=quant-v3.0 --note=\"auto-rollback\"
```
ops-oncall: noted. ops runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/quant-rollback
ritesh: will capture token-diff artifacts at each stage: /artifacts/7165432100/diff-stage-*.txt
deploy-bot: Deploy started: stage=10% (slice=night-qa). monitor: https://deploys.redwood.internal/7165432100
deploy-bot: Stage=10% complete. No alerts in 8m. progressing to 60%.
deploy-bot: Stage=60% complete. p99 +0.11s, error_rate 0.03%. advancing to 100%.
deploy-bot: Stage=100% complete. Post-deploy smoke ok. diffs=/artifacts/7165432100/diff-full.txt
tariq: checked KV-cache metrics and token diffs — small expected deltas, no integrity issues. memory stable.
emily: validated model diff sample; nothing suspicious. adding a note to release-notes: \"quant-kernel v3.1: GEMM packing improvements; minor p99 tail increase on some long sequences noted in QA — monitoring.\"
sam: pinned bundle in release-qa deploy config to sha256:ff12c9... and documented rollback command.
ops-oncall: handing off to release for write-up. If anything surfaces, re-open this thread.
ritesh: thanks everyone. closing thread; will reopen if post-release telemetry pops any alerts. :rocket:
thread_summary: Gated staged rollout of quant-kernel v3.1 into release-qa: preflight checks, pinned bundle hash, rollback command and thresholds, staged progress updates, token-diff artifacts, and post-deploy validation.
